attribution: Color measurements and paint properties from artistpigments.org (CC BY-NC 4.0)
notes: Lines included have color data for at least two-thirds of their listed paints. Only paints with color data are included.

L/a/b are CIELAB masstone values (full-strength paint) as shown on artistpigments.org, measured by the site. For opaque media, lighter values come from mixing with white, not dilution, so these points are the dark/saturated end of each paint's range.
measurement: how the site got the value (e.g. "Chart" = manufacturer chart, "Handmade masstone sample" = hand-painted swatch).
lightfastness is each brand's own scale; astm is the ASTM rating where given.
discontinued = site marks the paint as no longer available.
lf is lightfastness normalized to 1 (best) - 4 (poor) across brand scales; lfRaw is the brand's own rating.
trans: T, ST, SO, O. pig: Colour Index codes. src: chart (printed chart) or maker (manufacturer data).
